example.pinyin: nǐ bié zǒu, wǒ mǎshàng jiù huílái.
example.gloss: Don't go, I'll be right back.

vocab.gloss: to express; to show; to say

example.pinyin: tā diǎntóu biǎoshì tā dǒng le.
example.gloss: He nodded to show that he understood.

vocab.gloss: to pass; to go through; process

example.hanzi: 我每天都會經過那家咖啡店。
example.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu huì jīngguò nà jiā kāfēi diàn.
example.gloss: I pass by that coffee shop every day.

example.pinyin: zhè ge chéngshì de lìshǐ hěn cháng.
example.gloss: This city has a long history.

example.hanzi: 妹妹哭了，她說她的車票不見了。
example.pinyin: mèimei kū le, tā shuō tā de chēpiào bú jiàn le.
example.gloss: My little sister cried; she said her ticket was gone.

vocab.gloss: to dare; daring; (polite) may I venture

example.hanzi: 我不敢一個人騎車去那麼遠的地方。
example.pinyin: wǒ bù gǎn yí ge rén qí chē qù nàme yuǎn de dìfāng.
example.gloss: I don't dare ride that far all by myself.

grammar.title: 馬上就… (right away / immediately)
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 馬上 + 就 + 動詞 (+ 了)
grammar.explanation: 馬上 means "at once, right away". In Taiwan Mandarin it very often goes together with 就 before the verb: 馬上就+動詞. Adding 了 at the end shows the action happens or is about to happen very soon. 馬上就要…了 means something is about to start.

examples.pinyin: diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù yào kāishǐ le.
examples.gloss: The movie is about to start.

examples.hanzi: 我吃完飯馬上就去找你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ chī wán fàn mǎshàng jiù qù zhǎo nǐ.
examples.gloss: I'll go find you right after I finish eating.

examples.hanzi: 媽媽一說，他馬上就懂了。
examples.pinyin: māma yì shuō, tā mǎshàng jiù dǒng le.
examples.gloss: As soon as Mom explained, he understood right away.

grammar.title: 敢 / 不敢 + 動詞 (dare / not dare to do)
grammar.pattern: 主語 + (不) 敢 + 動詞
grammar.explanation: 敢 goes before a verb to say someone dares to do something; the negative 不敢 is far more common in daily speech. To ask a question, use 敢不敢 or 敢…嗎.

examples.hanzi: 我不敢跟老闆說這件事。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù gǎn gēn lǎobǎn shuō zhè jiàn shì.
examples.gloss: I don't dare tell the boss about this.

examples.pinyin: nǐ gǎn bu gǎn chī chòudòufu?
examples.gloss: Do you dare eat stinky tofu?

examples.hanzi: 他不敢哭，因為爸爸就在旁邊。
examples.pinyin: tā bù gǎn kū, yīnwèi bàba jiù zài pángbiān.
examples.gloss: He didn't dare cry, because Dad was right beside him.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你怎麼了？眼睛紅紅的，是不是哭了？
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ zěnme le? yǎnjīng hónghóng de, shì bú shì kū le?
dialogue.gloss: What's up? Your eyes are red — were you crying?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: méiyǒu la, shì fēng tài dà.
dialogue.gloss: No I wasn't — it's just that the wind is too strong.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 好啦，我們馬上就到了，經過前面那間店，右轉就到。
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo la, wǒmen mǎshàng jiù dào le, jīngguò qiánmiàn nà jiān diàn, yòu zhuǎn jiù dào.
dialogue.gloss: OK, we're almost there — go past that shop up ahead, turn right and we're there.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 那間店很有歷史喔，我媽說她小時候就在那裡買糖。
dialogue.pinyin: nà jiān diàn hěn yǒu lìshǐ o, wǒ mā shuō tā xiǎo shíhòu jiù zài nàlǐ mǎi táng.
dialogue.gloss: That shop has a lot of history! My mom says she bought candy there when she was little.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 真的嗎？我都不敢問老闆他幾歲了。
dialogue.pinyin: zhēn de ma? wǒ dōu bù gǎn wèn lǎobǎn tā jǐ suì le.
dialogue.gloss: Really? I never dare ask the owner how old he is.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 別問啦！不過他人很好，每次都多給我一塊糖，表示歡迎。
dialogue.pinyin: bié wèn la! búguò tā rén hěn hǎo, měi cì dōu duō gěi wǒ yí kuài táng, biǎoshì huānyíng.
dialogue.gloss: Don't ask! But he's really nice — every time he gives me an extra candy to show I'm welcome.

sentences.gloss: My little brother is crying very loudly.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù gǎn yí ge rén qù
sentences.gloss: I don't dare go by myself.
He nodded to show he agreed.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān jīngguò zhè jiā diàn
sentences.gloss: I pass this shop every day.

example.hanzi: 我下午有一個重要的會議。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu yí ge zhòngyào de huìyì.
example.gloss: I have an important meeting this afternoon.

vocab.gloss: frequently; constantly; regularly; often; day-to-day; everyday; daily

example.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng dā jiéyùn qù shàngbān.
example.gloss: He often takes the MRT to work.

example.hanzi: 早上氣溫很低,要多穿一點。
example.pinyin: Zǎoshang qìwēn hěn dī, yào duō chuān yìdiǎn.
example.gloss: The temperature is low in the morning; wear a bit more.

example.hanzi: 這個電視節目很好看,我每週都看。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge diànshì jiémù hěn hǎokàn, wǒ měi zhōu dōu kàn.
example.gloss: This TV program is great; I watch it every week.

example.hanzi: 多運動對身體健康很好。
example.pinyin: Duō yùndòng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng hěn hǎo.
example.gloss: Exercising more is good for your health.

vocab.gloss: to act on; to affect; action

example.hanzi: 這個藥的作用很快,吃了就不痛了。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge yào de zuòyòng hěn kuài, chī le jiù bú tòng le.
example.gloss: This medicine acts fast; after taking it, it doesn't hurt anymore.

grammar.title: 用「經常」表示常常做的事
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 經常 + 動詞短語
grammar.explanation: 「經常」是頻率副詞,放在動詞前面,表示這件事很常發生,比「有時候」多很多。台灣口語裡也常說「常常」,「經常」語氣比較正式一點,常用在工作或生活習慣上。否定要說「不經常」或「很少」。

examples.hanzi: 我經常在家看電視節目。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīngcháng zài jiā kàn diànshì jiémù.
examples.gloss: I often watch TV programs at home.

examples.hanzi: 他經常運動,身體很健康。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng yùndòng, shēntǐ hěn jiànkāng.
examples.gloss: He exercises often, and he's very healthy.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 你明天早上有時間嗎?我們去喝咖啡。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān zǎoshang yǒu shíjiān ma? Wǒmen qù hē kāfēi.
dialogue.gloss: Do you have time tomorrow morning? Let's go for coffee.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 沒有耶,我們公司明天有會議。
dialogue.pinyin: Méiyǒu ye, wǒmen gōngsī míngtiān yǒu huìyì.
dialogue.gloss: Nope, our company has a meeting tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.gloss: You guys have meetings a lot, huh?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊,所以我每天睡得很少,身體不太健康。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, suǒyǐ wǒ měitiān shuì de hěn shǎo, shēntǐ bú tài jiànkāng.
dialogue.gloss: Yeah, so I sleep very little every day and I'm not very healthy.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 那你早點睡,也多運動,對健康很有作用。
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ zǎo diǎn shuì, yě duō yùndòng, duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu zuòyòng.
dialogue.gloss: Then sleep earlier and exercise more; it really helps your health.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 好啦,我明天下班後就去跑步,晚上再看電視節目。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo la, wǒ míngtiān xiàbān hòu jiù qù pǎobù, wǎnshàng zài kàn diànshì jiémù.
dialogue.gloss: OK, tomorrow after work I'll go running, and watch TV programs at night.

sentences.gloss: We have a meeting tomorrow afternoon.

sentences.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de qìwēn hěn dī.
sentences.gloss: Last night's temperature was very low.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jiémù zhēn de hěn hǎokàn.
Yùndòng duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu zuòyòng.
sentences.gloss: Exercise really has an effect on your health.

example.hanzi: 那家店在車站的西邊,很好找。
example.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zài chēzhàn de xībiān, hěn hǎo zhǎo.
example.gloss: That shop is on the west side of the station; it's easy to find.

vocab.gloss: different; wrong; mistaken; to fall short; to lack

example.hanzi: 我的漢語還很差,要多學一點。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ hái hěn chà, yào duō xué yìdiǎn.
example.gloss: My Chinese is still poor; I need to study more.

example.hanzi: 我姐姐下個月要結婚了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie xià ge yuè yào jiéhūn le.
example.gloss: My older sister is getting married next month.

example.hanzi: 這條路很短,走十分鐘就到了。
example.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn duǎn, zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
example.gloss: This road is short; you get there in a ten-minute walk.

vocab.gloss: to agree; to consent; to approve

example.pinyin: Wǒ hěn tóngyì nǐ shuō de huà.
example.gloss: I quite agree with what you said.

example.hanzi: 你可以教我怎麼用悠遊卡嗎?
example.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ zěnme yòng Yōuyóukǎ ma?
example.gloss: Can you teach me how to use an EasyCard?

grammar.title: 差不多:about the same / roughly
grammar.pattern: A 跟 B + 差不多 + (形容詞);差不多 + 數量/時間
grammar.explanation: 差不多 means "about the same" or "roughly". Put 「A 跟 B 差不多 + adjective」 to say two things are similar, or put 差不多 before a number/time to mean "about, approximately". It is very common in daily Taiwan speech.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ gē chàbùduō gāo.
examples.gloss: My older brother and I are about the same height.

examples.hanzi: 這兩條路差不多長,你選哪條都可以。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo lù chàbùduō cháng, nǐ xuǎn nǎ tiáo dōu kěyǐ.
examples.gloss: These two roads are about the same length; pick either one.

examples.pinyin: Tā chàbùduō qī diǎn bàn dào jiā.
examples.gloss: He gets home at about seven thirty.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 你知道嗎?小明下個月要結婚了耶!
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Xiǎomíng xià ge yuè yào jiéhūn le ye!
dialogue.gloss: Did you know? Xiaoming is getting married next month!

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 真的啊?他們認識的時間很短耶。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn de a? Tāmen rènshì de shíjiān hěn duǎn ye.
dialogue.gloss: Really? They've known each other for such a short time.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊,差不多半年,不過他爸媽也同意了。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, chàbùduō bàn nián, búguò tā bàmā yě tóngyì le.
dialogue.gloss: Yeah, about half a year, but his parents agreed too.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 那很好啊!他們家在哪裡?
dialogue.pinyin: Nà hěn hǎo a! Tāmen jiā zài nǎlǐ?
dialogue.gloss: That's great! Where is their home?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 在火車站的西邊,不遠,搭捷運就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài huǒchēzhàn de xībiān, bù yuǎn, dā jiéyùn jiù dào le.
dialogue.gloss: West of the train station, not far—just take the MRT.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 我想買點東西送他們,你教我選,好嗎?
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎn dōngxi sòng tāmen, nǐ jiāo wǒ xuǎn, hǎo ma?
dialogue.gloss: I want to buy something for them—can you teach me how to choose?

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xià ge yuè yào jiéhūn le.
sentences.gloss: They are getting married next month.

sentences.pinyin: Yóujú jiù zài yínháng de xībiān.
sentences.gloss: The post office is just west of the bank.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge jiémù tài duǎn le.

sentences.gloss: He teaches us Chinese every day.
